canonical.form: one file, no copier header, exactly 1048576 bytes
canonical.note: A 512 byte copier header describes the same bytes. Strip it first, then compare. Every digest below is of the bare file.

artifacts.name: Dungeon Master, USA
artifacts.provenance: Measured on this machine from a bare file with no copier header. No-Intro names this dump Dungeon Master (USA).

artifacts.name: Dungeon Master, Japan
artifacts.provenance: No dump held. No-Intro lists a base release and a Rev 1. Digests are left empty rather than guessed, and the build refuses this entry until they are measured.

artifacts.name: Dungeon Master, UK and Europe
artifacts.provenance: No dump held. Digests are left empty rather than guessed, and the build refuses this entry until they are measured.

not_this.name: An image this project already produced
not_this.why: A build output declares chipset 0x02 and is larger than the retail dump. Feeding one back in is a mistake, not a dump, and the build says so rather than patching it twice.

externalNote: Every file this repository reads and may not ship, each kept under external/, which git and Dropbox both ignore. The artifacts list above identifies the dump; this mapping is where every file sits. python3 -m conformance.external reports which are here, which are missing and which are not the file named; SHA-256 alone decides.

roms-dungeon-master-usa-sfc.purpose: The Dungeon Master (USA) cartridge dump the patch, the placement and the census read; the artifacts list above declares the same digests.
